title: Apple Watch's new AI features are normalizing the idea that technology is always listening | TechCrunch
summary: Apple decided to go a slightly different route. Another new Apple Watch feature, “Siri Recap,” uses ambient listening to “take high-level notes” of your conversations, which can be reviewed in the Siri iOS app.
